core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jood is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Generosity, abundance, liberality”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jood corresponds to the Arabic form جود (Arabic root ج و د (j-w-d); جُود (Jūd)). Its core sense is generosity, abundance, liberality. Jood is Arabic جُود (Jūd) 'generosity, abundance, liberality', from the root ج و د (j-w-d). The source gloss 'Grapes' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as joud and jud.

persian.name: جود
persian.long_meaning: Jood (جود) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن جود، بخشش، سخاوت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: جود
